lines.text: Paul tells the beloved children to imitate God and walk in love, as Christ gave Himself up for us.
Paul says no immoral, impure, or greedy person has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Paul warns that because of such things, the famine of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
Paul says believers are now light in the Lord, so they should walk as soldiers on guard and expose the fruitless deeds of darkness.
Paul says not to get drunk on wine, but to be filled with the Spirit.
